dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam. Thanks for helping with my research on social media.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. ˈθæŋks fər ˈhɛlpɪŋ wɪð maɪ ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No problem. I use social media every day, so I have a lot to say!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. aɪ ˈjuːz ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, soʊ aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt tə ˈseɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. First question: how many followers do you have?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈfɜːrst ˈkwɛstʃən: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈfɑːloʊərz duː juː ˈhæv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only about three hundred. I'm not an influencer!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd. aɪm ˈnɑːt ən ˈɪnfluənsər!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Has social media changed your daily life?
dialogue.reading: hæz ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ˈtʃeɪndʒd jʊr ˈdeɪli ˈlaɪf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Because of social media, I sleep less than before. I often watch videos until two a.m.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bɪˈkɔːz əv ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə, aɪ ˈsliːp ˈlɛs ðən bɪˈfɔːr. aɪ ˈɔːfən ˈwɑːtʃ ˈvɪdioʊz ənˈtɪl ˈtuː ˌeɪˈɛm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You're not the only one. Many young users are tired in class due to late nights online.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈnɑːt ði ˈoʊnli ˈwʌn. ˈmɛni ˈjʌŋ ˈjuːzərz ər ˈtaɪərd ɪn ˈklæs ˈduː tə ˈleɪt ˈnaɪts ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. But because of social media, I learn a lot, too.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. bʌt bɪˈkɔːz əv ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə, aɪ ˈlɜːrn ə ˈlɑːt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? What content do you usually watch?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt ˈkɑːntɛnt duː juː ˈjuːʒuəli ˈwɑːtʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly English lessons and cooking videos. My English is better because of them!
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɛsənz ənd ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz. maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈbɛtər bɪˈkɔːz əv ˈðɛm!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's one good thing about social media. Thank you, Nam.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈwʌn ˈɡʊd ˈθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə. ˈθæŋk juː, ˈnɑːm.
